 Eight more die of dengue
 Published : 2 November 2026
 • 
 Updated : 2 November 2026, 08:02
 • 
 BANGLADESH
 SHARE 
 Staff Correspondent 
 At least eight dengue patients died and 1,929 others were hospitalised in the 24 hours till 8:00am yesterday, according to the Directorate General of Health Services.
 Of the deaths, three were reported in Dhaka, two in Mymensingh division, and one each in Chattogram, Rajshahi and Khulna divisions.
 Tap here to add The Daily Star as a trusted source 
 The total death toll rose to 427, while the number of cases reached 1,36,929.
 Currently, 6,114 dengue patients are undergoing treatment at hospitals.
